evidence.proved: the Personal card reads $0 forever with unlimited use on your own API keys or external agents, quoted; Pro is USD 10 a month and is the first tier with Zed-hosted models
the FAQ says the Personal plan is for users who want the editor without AI capabilities or who prefer their own keys, quoted

notes: Zed is a desktop application, so its free lane needs a machine. The vendor serves no tokens on the free tier, which is the fact the word free hides.
